mansion_state_tracker.agent_description: Tracks and analyzes the gate states, switches, and floor transitions of the Pokémon Mansion to help solve the puzzles.
mansion_state_tracker.agent_system_prompt: You are an expert tracker of Pokémon Mansion state. Your role is to analyze current overworld screenshots, coordinate grids, and historical logs to maintain a precise model of active switches, open/closed shutter gates (State A vs State B), and floor connections across 1F, 2F, 3F, and B1F.
mansion_state_tracker.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"mansion_state": {"type": "string", "description": "The current observed state of the mansion gates and switches."}}, "required": ["mansion_state"]}
mansion_state_tracker.agent_output_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"active_state": {"type": "string", "description": "The determined active state of the mansion (State A or State B)."}, "open_gates": {"type": "string", "description": "List of currently open gates based on the active state."}}, "required": ["active_state", "open_gates"]}
